details.name: Gilberta
details.quote: Hi there! Oh, you have the rosy scent of beautiful memories ... like an incomplete letter destined for a special place. I wonder where that might be.
details.infection: Oripathy negative, based on medical examination reports.
details.exp1d: Adventure: Messenger's Vacay Snacks, cameras, sun hats, and cosmetics. Oh, and don't forget to bring the positive feels and vibes for the journey.
details.exp2d: Originium Arts: Gravity Shock Gilberta doesn't get seasick, but she might get a case of "groundsickness" if she has been flying around for too long.
details.hb1d: Fashion: Color Aficionado Gilberta knows every color by its code, and she knows what everyone's favorite color is.
details.hb2d: Culture: Romantic Footnote Who bookmarked the sweetest part of the romance? And who scribbled something next to the drawing of the happily ever after?
